sanitizedCandidate.objective: Execute a fully validated, evidence-backed technical readiness and validation cycle over 48 hours for a planned release, performed exclusively by two engineers without performing any operations that alter production data, configuration, or compute resources.

risks.risk: Staging environment diverges from production topology
risks.mitigation: Run automated infrastructure diff tools twice daily and halt validation if variance exceeds defined thresholds

risks.risk: Insufficient telemetry data limits evidence quality
risks.mitigation: Seed synthetic traffic generators in the sandbox prior to start time and configure high-fidelity logging pipelines

risks.risk: Human error due to fatigue during extended window
risks.mitigation: Implement strict 4-hour shift rotations between the two engineers and require pair-review for all output artifacts

verification: All static code analysis and dependency scanning reports return zero critical or high vulnerabilities
Load simulation in the sandbox matches projected production capacity requirements
Integration test suite passes with full coverage against mocked external service contracts
sanitizedCandidate.rollback: Archive current staging artifacts and revert local development branches to the baseline commit hash; since no production resources were mutated, live system state remains unchanged and requires no recovery action.
sanitizedCandidate.stopCondition: Immediately suspend work if any security vulnerability reaches critical severity level or if personnel count deviates from the two-engineer requirement.
